messages:
Jasper Chen: Quick heads-up — Equinox (large FinTech customer) asked for a console widget that correlates cost, latency, and traces per-tenant. They want a short demo next Wed. Can product / eng give scope + ETA?
Maria Lopez: Need the ask broken down. What are the must-haves vs nice-to-haves? Who from their side will be demoing?
Jasper Chen: Copied the customer's list: 1) heatmap of cost vs p95 latency per tenant 2) click into any cell -> list of top routes + links to traces 3) ability to slice by model, route, and region 4) CSV export and scheduled reports 5) tenant-level RBAC so their ops only see their own data. They said live links to traces are critical.
Anika Rao: Live trace links are doable but expensive at scale. Do they need complete end-to-end traces for every point or sampled traces with jump-to-full-trace?
Jasper Chen: They said "live links for high-latency spikes" — basically trace-on-demand when a cell exceeds threshold.
Leo Patel: Operational note: cross-joining cost telemetry at request-level will blow up query cost if we do it raw. We should consider pre-aggregated buckets (1m bins) + sampling for trace collection. Also point out retention: storing per-request cost for 12 months is heavy.
Maria Lopez: Proposed MVP scope: - heatmap UI with configurable KPI (cost / p95) - drilldown page with top routes and sample traces (not full request logs) - CSV export for the drilldown - RBAC routing for tenant view - objective perf target: UI loads under 2s for default time window. Launch criteria: UX mock, eng perf baseline, e2e test with synthetic tenants, and docs. Anything else?
Rajiv Menon: Sales: timeline is somewhat firm. Equinox is pressure-testing for next-gen contract. If we can pilot with them in 4 weeks that would help close. They are willing to be a pilot partner and provide usage examples.
Anika Rao: Ballpark engineering estimate for the MVP: 3 full-stack tickets + 2 infra tickets + 1 telemetry infra refactor. With 2 engineers + 1 SRE working in parallel, ~5-6 weeks. If we include full per-request cost linkage and long retention, add 4-6 weeks.
Maria Lopez: Tradeoffs noted. Can we scope the pilot to 1 week of retention, 1m buckets, sampled traces? That'll keep effort low and still prove value. If pilot successful, we iterate to longer retention and more granular joins.
asper (typo) <- ignore
Leo Patel: For sampling strategy: trigger full trace capture when cell latency exceeds configurable threshold or when cost per-token spike > X. We also need a guardrail so export jobs don't block realtime.
Maria Lopez: Acceptance criteria for pilot: 1) Heatmap MVP in Console, 2) Drilldown shows top 10 routes with a sample trace link, 3) CSV export works, 4) RBAC prevents tenant bleed, 5) No >2s median load on 95th traffic slice.
Anika Rao: I'll write a short spec and attach rough data model + query approach. Also need to figure out metrics ingestion hook from runtime — does serving runtime send per-request cost metadata today? @Leo, can infra add a small tag in telemetry?
Leo Patel: We can add a lightweight cost tag in the request envelope (cost_estimate_usd). Should be a small runtime change + a pipeline mapping. I'll estimate infra effort after spec.
deploy-bot: Note: last console-export job ran at 03:12 UTC, size 43MB.
Maria Lopez: Next steps: 1) Anika files spec doc and ping eng-sre thread by EOD Friday. 2) Jasper to gather Equinox's example tenants and a sample span that they'd want to link. 3) Schedule scoping call Monday 10am PT (product + eng + SRE + sales). Everyone ok?
Jasper Chen: Yep — I'll lock the call and get the tenant artifacts. Thanks all.
Anika Rao: Ack — I'll start the spec draft, will include a data sampling proposal and perf mitigation plan.
Leo Patel: I'll sketch infra checklist and costs to run the queries.
Maria Lopez: Great. Tagging action owners in the spec. If pilot goes well, we'll add to roadmap for Q3 runbook and GA.
Rajiv Menon: I'll manage expectations with Equinox and confirm pilot OK for 4-6 week delivery.
Maria Lopez: Closing: scoping call invite up in 15m.
